parts.rule1.title: 1. Real in-app balance
parts.rule1.text: Never hand over the item on the strength of a simple text message. Always check the actual credit in your Mobile Money app.
parts.rule2.title: 2. Safe areas
parts.rule2.text: Choose well-lit shopping centres with CCTV.
parts.rule3.title: 3. Validation code
parts.rule3.text: Ask for the buyer's 4-digit hand-over code, shown in their Dilchap app, before closing the sale.
